One word in this sentence is wrong. Find it.

“Before the conference, the two researchers revised its findings and added a new chart.” Trace the pronoun back to its noun.

Comment the word you'd fix.

youtube.title: SAT Grammar: Spot the Pronoun Error
youtube.description: A pronoun has to match the noun it points back to. Plural “researchers” needs “their,” not “its.”
